name: Amit Das
role: Professor & Senior Associate Dean, Graduate Programmes
bio: Professor Amit Das has three decades of post-PhD experience in teaching data science and information systems at the undergraduate and graduate levels at Nanyang Technological University (Singapore), Qatar University (Qatar), and Krea University (India). During this time, he has also researched decision-making and information systems, for which he collaborated with several organisations in the private, public, and people sectors. He holds a BTech degree from the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur and a PGDM from the Indian Institute of Management Calcutta.

sections.title: Research
paragraphs: Machine Learning Models in Bankruptcy Prediction; Adoption and Use of E-Government around the World.
